answer: Post a stake bond of B per identity, and the ledger credits work only after k=2 peers re-execute the receipt and match the output hash. With B=500 POA and a 30 day unbonding window, a 1,000-identity farm locks 500,000 POA and needs 2,000 independent re-executions before it earns one epoch. A meadow of honest agents re-executes 3 receipts per hour. A prism of copied receipts fails the hash match on the first replay. The karst of sybils has no cheap path through 500,000.
